metadata.hardware_requirements: NVIDIA Quadro K620 GPU and Intel Xeon CPU E5-1650 (3.6 GHz, 6 cores) ("NVIDIA Quadro K620 GPU and Intel Xeon CPU E5-1650")

nodes_source.source_quote: A series of simulation experiments based on real-world traffic data are conducted to evaluate the proposed approach.
nodes_source.description: Empirical traffic data including volumes and vehicle locations extracted from video frames at a freeway merge area connecting Qingdao and Huangdao in Shandong, China.
nodes_source.reproducibility_rationale: The paper states that the data used to support the results are available from the corresponding author upon request.

nodes_process.node_name: Vehicle position extraction and matrix formation
nodes_process.source_quote: Vehicle locations are extracted from the traffic video frames and are reformed as position matrices.
nodes_process.description: Extracts vehicle coordinates (xi, yi) from raw video and maps them to a position matrix mt of size X by Y. Signal states are embedded as constant values UG or UR at the signal location (xR, yR).
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, generic tools unstated, matrix dimensions and embedding logic fully specified.

nodes_process.source_quote: we stack the matrices of consecutive N time steps to represent the state st.
nodes_process.description: Consecutive matrices are stacked to capture vehicle dynamics. Down-sampling is applied to reduce input dimensions before feeding into the network.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=3, down-sampling ratio not explicitly defined.

nodes_process.source_quote: A multitask learning strategy is implemented in the training process to improve learning efficiency.
nodes_process.description: Trains a CNN-based Q-network using Algorithm 1. Uses Adam optimizer to minimize a total loss function L consisting of Q-learning loss (L1) and speed/queue prediction loss (L2).
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, all hyperparameters and network structure (Figure 7) detailed.

nodes_process.source_quote: The proposed method is evaluated in SUMO, an open-source microscopic traffic simulator.
nodes_process.description: Simulation of the Qingdao-Huangdao freeway tunnel area. The DRL agent interacts with the environment to determine green/red phases every decision step L.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, tools and parameters fully specified for simulation setup.

nodes_process.source_quote: A perturbation analysis is conducted to evaluate the impact of information contained in video data.
nodes_process.description: The control area is divided into 8 subareas. Information is removed from individual subareas to evaluate the impact on travel time performance.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, setup well defined, generic tools used.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Convergence curves for (a) episode reward and (b) mean travel time.
nodes_sink.description: Line plots showing the training convergence of the agent's reward and the resulting mean travel time over 1 million frames.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Uses standard DQN and SUMO; hyperparameters are listed. Source traffic data is available only upon request.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 9 presents the Q1 (25%), Q2 (50%), and Q3 (75%) of the travel times in the mainline for three scenarios.
nodes_sink.description: Comparison of vehicle travel times across three control scenarios (No control, PI-ALINEA, and Deep RL) showing median and interquartile ranges.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Results follow directly from simulation outputs using described metrics; source data access is the only bottleneck.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Table 2 presents mean vehicle travel times in 20 simulation experiments (s).
nodes_sink.description: Numerical mean travel times and percentage improvements for PI-ALINEA and DRL compared to no-control across 20 independent simulation runs.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Tabulated data is highly specific and matches the figures' claims; relies on reproducible SUMO simulation.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 10 presents the temporal-spatial distribution of the mean speeds along the mainline.
nodes_sink.description: Heatmaps showing speed variations over distance and time for no-control, PI-ALINEA, and DRL scenarios to identify bottlenecks.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Clear visualization of simulation state; requires extraction of spatial speed data from SUMO.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 11 presents the Q1, Q2, and Q3 of the queue lengths at the on-ramp in three scenarios.
nodes_sink.description: Distribution of vehicle queue lengths at the on-ramp over the simulation period for the different control methods.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Derived from standard simulation logs; procedure for quantile calculation is standard.

nodes_sink.description: Box plots of traffic volume downstream of the merging area at 5-minute intervals for three scenarios.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Direct aggregation of downstream flow measurements from simulation.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 16 presents the box plot of travel time when the information of different subareas is removed.
nodes_sink.description: Sensitivity analysis results showing mean travel time impact when masking specific spatial subareas (1-8) of the input video data.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Procedure for 'removing information' (masking subareas) is specified, but exact mask coordinates are only visually indicated.
